description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeTimesheetListAPI class, which tests the 'getAll' API endpoint for employee timesheets within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup for fixtures, mock services, and various test methods for API operations, including unimplemented 'create', 'delete', and validation methods.
